source: Original CAS03 uncontracted_research_targets is provenance of proposed definitions, not automatic author input admission; no old axis proof consumed.

candidate_C02.frame: g=diag(-1,1,1,1), K=(-1,n), n.n=1, n1 first spatial component
candidate_C02.domains: epsilon,chi,b2,b3 real; epsilon is family amplitude (not energy density). rchi=(sinh chi,cosh chi,0,0), rchi_flat=g rchi=(-sinh chi,cosh chi,0,0).
candidate_C02.family: B_epsilon_chi=epsilon rchi_flat rchi_flat^T + b2 e2_flat e2_flat^T + b3 e3_flat e3_flat^T
candidate_C02.slope_reference: Compare B_epsilon_chi(K,K) with B_epsilon_0(K,K) holding epsilon,b2,b3,n fixed
candidate_C02.rank_control: Rest spatial block at chi=0 is diag(epsilon,b2,b3); count zero eigenvalues by actual parameter cases, including repeated nonzero/allzero. Do not assume positive/nonzero eigenvalues globally.

candidate_C03.original_all_invertible_D_part: For arbitrary real invertible D=H I+sigma with tr sigma=0,H=tr(D)/3, h1=-2D beta. Exact beta=-D^-1 h1/2 remains valid even H=0.
candidate_C03.truncation_part_new_guard: Only on H!=0 define beta_trunc=-(I-sigma/H) h1/(2H), and derive beta-beta_trunc=(sigma^2/H^2) beta. This is fixed-shear exact linear algebra, no O(beta^2) Taylor assertion.
candidate_C03.zero_H_control: D=diag(1,1,-2) invertible, det=-2, H=0: exact inverse valid but truncation undefined; retain as domain control, not silently remove.
candidate_C03.scope_diff: Explicit C03 split introduces necessary H!=0 domain only to the truncated expression. Original contract/FAILURE/aggregate kept. O(beta^2) remainder and lost-gap uniform inverse remain HOLD.

owner_decision_required: Admit the C02 neutral family/reference definitions and C03 per-subtarget H guard in a distinct successor; current general input-recovery permission does not silently authorize this domain change.
